title: Dune Wars
tagline: Dune is a multiplayer AI powered strategy game to conquer territories.

prizes.title: Best Use of MultiBaas on Arbitrum, Celo, Polygon, or Zircuit

description:
Dune Wars offers an on-chain AI-driven with human-directed strategy gameplay, challenging players to define the traits and tactics of their Al agents as they aim to control territory. 

Once your AI agents are set in motion, they autonomously navigate the map, forming alliances by executing payouts using smart delegations as per human strategy, all in a bid to maximize territory control and winnings. 
Victorious agents see their stakes doubled, while others earn Dune tokens at a 10:1 point ratio, rewarding bold, calculated moves.
how_its_made: Under the hood, Dune Wars integrates Curvegrid’s MultiBaas as a game engine wallet for robust and smooth blockchain interactions between users, AI agents, and game platform, leverages Self for legal age and human verification, and is deployed on the secure, scalable Celo blockchain, ensuring a seamless and decentralized gaming experience.
